data.content_ref: inline:conn:204d29004328 DEPENDS ON SRC_001's identification of the modular-inverse step as the causal link between the two congruences: SRC_001 establishes that computing 5⁻¹ mod 7 = 3 is the irreducible operation that transforms two independent congruences into a single residue class mod 35. All concrete methods (SRC_003's substitution, SRC_004's formula, SRC_005's search) implicitly or explicitly depend on this inverse existing and being computable. This dependence is REFUTED IF the modular inverse of 5 mod 7 is not 3, or if a solution method exists that solves the system without any reliance on the invertibility of 5 modulo 7 (e.g., a purely additive construction).
